narr: A slow-moving upper level low pressure system moved across Northeast Pennsylvania during the day. This feature triggered scattered thunderstorms with locally heavy rainfall that led to isolated flash flooding of roads.
ev: PA 507 was closed both directions at the intersection of Lake View Road in Palmyra Township. The road was closed due to flooding in several locations.
PA 296 was closed at PA 196 in South Canaan Township, Wayne County. The road was flooded.
